notes:
- Everything opens in one tab now; ⌘-click opens a new tab. Back and Forward move through what you opened.
- The New button shows only what fits the section you're in.
- Every project has one Character’s Map, ready from the start.
- Rename a character in their note and the script and map follow.
- Notes and Review stay in the right sidebar in every section.
- Outlines have a calm grey background (choose another in the right sidebar) and no longer drift off into empty space.
- A page ruler under the timeline; columns keep the height you give them; Show in Finder on any file.
- A new mono app icon.
